name: Tailscale Serve
description: Serves a local port over tailscale serve or funnel. Defaults to the valet-ui port.

mode.title: Exposure
mode.description: Funnel puts the port on the public internet. Tailscale refuses ports it does not allow for funnel.

httpsPort.title: HTTPS port
httpsPort.description: Port on the tailnet (or public) side. 443 unless you serve a second service.

target.title: Target
target.description: Port, host:port, URL or unix:/path.sock. Blank serves the valet-ui address.

command.title: CLI command
command.description: Binary to run, may include args. Use "sudo tailscale" when serve config needs root.
